title: Klint Kubiak on QB change: We're thinking about everything to fix our problems

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Klint Kubiak on QB change: We're thinking about everything to fix our problems
sources.description: The Raiders lost their fourth straight game on Sunday and head coach Klint Kubiak said that nothing is off the table as they consider ways to halt their slide.
